lever: Swapping saturated fats for unsaturated fats
intervention: Replacing saturated fat (fatty meat, butter, cheese, coconut and palm oil) with unsaturated fats (olive or rapeseed oil, nuts, seeds, oily fish)
summary: Replacing saturated fats with unsaturated fats lowers LDL cholesterol. This is one of the main dietary recommendations in European guidelines for high cholesterol.
whyThisGrade: Randomised trials summarised in a Cochrane review
Trials differed in what replaced the saturated fat

studies.title: Reduction in saturated fat intake for cardiovascular disease
